description: GTFS Estáticos | Serviços Municipalizados de Transportes Urbanos de Coimbra is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Coimbra. The Municipal Services of Urban Transport of Coimbra are responsible for the management of the network of buses and trolleybuses and a public elevator in the municipality of Coimbra. Coverage: Município de Coimbra. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS Static | Municipal Urban Transport Services of Coimbra" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Coimbra. Its keywords include smtuc-gtfs-static. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
